patch_description:
Add a shared mid-layer RZ gate (parameter "rz_mid") on all qubits immediately before the ZZZ three-qubit interactions. This provides global phase control right before the most expressive circuit components, which can help:
1. Improve optimization landscape by giving the optimizer a dedicated global phase knob
2. Reduce the train-validation gap by enabling finer control during the critical three-qubit interaction phase
3. Use only 1 additional parameter (shared across all 9 qubits) for better parameter efficiency
4. Mirror successful single-parameter phase boosts seen in prior generations

This lightweight modification should help the circuit learn better without significantly increasing complexity.
